programs.title: Beginner
programs.subtitle: Relaxed pace · learn the numbers
programs.description: Two-punch combos with plenty of time between calls. Focus on hitting the right spot and returning your hands to your chin.
tips: Snap every punch back to your guard.
Turn your rear hip on the 2.

programs.title: Intermediate
programs.subtitle: Steady pace · three-punch flow
programs.description: Three-punch combos at a steady pace. Keep your feet under you and flow from one punch into the next.
tips: Pivot on the lead foot for the 3.
Breathe out on every punch.

programs.title: Advanced
programs.subtitle: Fight pace · long combos
programs.description: Four-punch combos called at fight pace. Stay relaxed: tension makes you slow.
tips: Short, fast punches beat big wind-ups.
Keep the chin down through the whole combo.

programs.title: Jab Master
programs.subtitle: Outside fighter · control the distance
programs.description: Inspired by the great long-range boxers who won fights behind the jab. Double and triple jabs to measure, then the straight right down the middle.
tips: Step in with the jab, out after the 2.
Turn the jab over at the end: palm down.
Your rear hand stays glued to your cheek.

programs.title: Peek-a-Boo Pressure
programs.subtitle: Inside fighter · hooks and uppercuts
programs.description: Inspired by the compact pressure style: hands high, head moving, then explosive hooks and uppercuts from close range.
tips: Bend your knees and stay low.
Hooks come from the hips, not the arms.
Keep both gloves high between combos.

programs.title: Shoulder-Roll Counter
programs.subtitle: Defensive style · counter right hands
programs.description: Inspired by the shoulder-roll defenders: roll the shot off the lead shoulder, then fire the right hand and hook back.
tips: Imagine rolling a punch off your lead shoulder before each 2.
Counters are short and straight.
Reset your stance after every combo.

programs.title: Volume Puncher
programs.subtitle: Fast, non-stop combinations
programs.description: Inspired by the high-output fighters who overwhelm with speed and angles: long, fast combinations thrown in bunches.
tips: Speed over power: let the punches flow.
Exhale sharply on every punch.
Keep moving your feet between combos.

programs.title: Body Snatcher
programs.subtitle: Break them down to the body
programs.description: Inspired by the great body punchers: uppercuts and hooks that dig to the body, then come back up top.
tips: Drop your level with your legs, not your back.
Uppercuts travel straight up, close to your body.
